definitions.explanation: The act of returning something damaged or deteriorated to its original or proper condition. Used for physical objects, buildings, artwork, and abstract things like relationships.

examples.japanese: {関係|かんけい}を{修復|しゅうふく}する。
{壊|こわ}れた{橋|はし}の{修復|しゅうふく}{工事|こうじ}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Repair work on the damaged bridge has begun.

examples.japanese: {国宝|こくほう}の{絵画|かいが}を{修復|しゅうふく}するには{高度|こうど}な{技術|ぎじゅつ}と{長|なが}い{時間|じかん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Restoring a national treasure painting requires advanced skills and a long time.

notes:
Can be used for both physical repairs (buildings, artwork, infrastructure) and figurative restoration (relationships, trust, reputation). Compared to {修理|しゅうり} (repair), {修復|しゅうふく} implies restoring something closer to its original state and is often used for more significant or delicate work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{修復|しゅうふく}{工事|こうじ} (repair/restoration work)
・{関係|かんけい}を{修復|しゅうふく}する (mend a relationship)
・{修復|しゅうふく}{不可能|ふかのう} (beyond repair)
・{文化財|ぶんかざい}の{修復|しゅうふく} (restoration of cultural property)
